what_this_is: The kitchen and seeds of the three demo situations, nothing else. The world code (siteagent/world_dev/occlusion.py, refusal) refuses a kitchen that is not listed here and a noise or camera seed that falls in a block of another kitchen. Each entry gives one kitchen (first to last) with its status, and the noise/camera seed pair of one situation (the camera seed is the noise seed plus 1). Written for this package from the demo's own values; the development registry of the original project is not distributed.
